def: to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid

occurrences.text: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
